traditional: No classical doctrine: Pluto is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Drive meets power. Relentless force and a 'win at any cost' edge, with real capacity to eliminate or transform. Fused, these drives are difficult to separate and ask to be consciously integrated rather than acted out blindly.

cyclic.meaning: A new cycle of drive and power is sown: instinctive, full of potential, not yet conscious of itself.

business: Concentrated focus in this area. Formidable drive; temper and overkill are the dangers.
shadow: Anger and recklessness fused with control and obsession, with no distance to tell them apart.
arcApplying: The two fuse and intensify as they close in.
arcSeparating: The fused theme peaks and discharges.
base: A routine conflict can become a high-stakes power struggle once winning starts to matter more than the original issue.

readerCopy.body: A routine conflict can become a high-stakes power struggle once winning starts to matter more than the original issue. When Mars conjoins Pluto, action and power intensify each other, making force, advantage, and control harder to separate from the result anyone actually wants. Questions of control become harder to ignore once the argument starts producing consequences bigger than the original disagreement. Escalation can spend money, access, goodwill, or options that the actual goal still needs later. The strongest move protects the priority without turning every disagreement into a test of who can dominate whom.
